chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad, from ʿAli ibn Mahbub, from Ibn Ri'ab, from al-Halabi, from Abu ʿAbdillah عليه السلام, concerning:
Regarding a woman, when she dies and there is no woman with her to perform ghusl for her, he said: her husband should insert his hand beneath her shirt and wash her up to the elbows.

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman, referring here to the deceased wife
key_terms.تَحْتَ: beneath, indicating that the washing is done under the garment
key_terms.تُغَسِّلُهَا: to wash her ritually after death

ai.seo_question: Can a husband wash his deceased wife if no woman is available to perform her ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning the ghusl of a deceased wife when no other woman is present to wash her. It permits the husband to wash her in a limited manner by placing his hand beneath her garment and washing her up to the elbows.
